_sobre: Sound effects library. 'mixkit': sound id on mixkit.co (commercial use without attribution, https://mixkit.co/license/#sfxFree). 'elevenlabs': text used to generate the sound with the Sound Effects API (commercial on the paid plan), stored in sfx/elevenlabs/. 'use' picks the source when an item has both (without 'use', Mixkit wins). IFSCAPE_SFX=mixkit forces Mixkit for everything, for comparison. 'el_peak' is the second of the peak in the ElevenLabs file. 'start' skips the start of the file; 'gain' is the base volume; 'peak' is the second of the file where the impact lands (cues align this point with the event); 'end' trims the tail of the file (preview fade-out), and cues longer than the clip loop with a crossfade.
